authPolicy: Existing Firebase/Google + client email UI gate; static planning data and UI allowlist remain public
classification: APPROVED PUBLIC CURRENT-ROSTER DERIVED PLANNING DATA

exposure.scope: Current selectable roster; complete latest-visit historical crew display
exposed: Current employee display names and opaque package keys
Current employee speed, evidence, recent weekly hours and residual summaries
Role-conditioned account productivity, participation and experience for current employees
Supported account/store display choices and opaque account keys
Selected-week scheduled visit dates, times, customer number, address, contact, map and schedule notes
Aggregate visit workload, duration, crew size, seasonal/attendance and residual summaries
Limited incumbent reference duration/capacity/evidence/age weights and current-employee overlap membership required for numeric parity
All recorded members of latest store crew, including former employee display names, and selected latest-inventory production totals/export hours/recorded clocks when unambiguous
Current-employee regular/Modas and most-recent-account rate variants; aggregate original reference profiles and archived accuracy/error summaries
Frozen model trees, thresholds and feature names; cutoff/version/fingerprint
excluded: Selectable former staff and former-employee predictive profiles
Employee numbers and raw export/attendance records
Raw workbooks, bulk historical visits, visit dates and complete timesheet/export rows
Databases, source receipts, archives and backups
Local paths, credentials, tokens and source file hashes
exposure.warning: Anyone with the site URL can inspect the approved names and derived planning coefficients. This is not access-controlled data.

files.purpose: Exact release allowlist and exposure inventory
